**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nadia8666/pa-tools/commits/v0.0.2

- Add World Selector for bounds-based bulk selection and spatial comparison, with compressed bounds import and export.
- Restore extension toolbar buttons when PA Tools reloads.
- Include World Selector in the cross-platform bulk plugin installation task.

**TOOLS:**
_`paTools.lua` is a required plugin. Download other plugins as needed:_

| Name | Description |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| `PASync.lua` | Sync code and attribute changes bidirectionally with full Team Create support and per-place configs |
| `combinePlugin.lua` | Combine arbitrary parts, meshes, and unions into optimized bulk meshes with precise collision |
| `districtMapper.lua` | Edit the district nodemap and edit height boundaries |
| `holeCutter.lua` | Cut holes into groups of parts and merge axis-aligned part groups together |
| `worldSelector.lua` | Bulk select instances within 3D bounds and compare spatial diffs |
